info.title: stanzasharp
info.description: The stanzasharp command: downloads Stanza's English and German models for StanzaSharp, checked against their MD5s, e.g. in a Dockerfile or CI. "stanzasharp download DIR [--lang de] [--package default_fast] [--processors tokenize,mwt,pos]". "stanzasharp compare FILE" runs Python Stanza and StanzaSharp on your own text and shows whether their output is identical; "stanzasharp benchmark" measures both on your machine. Needs no native libtorch.

options.name: --lang
options.description: the language: en (default) or de (German)

options.name: --package
options.description:
Stanza's package: default, default_fast (faster, no constituency), default_accurate
(transformer models: slower, more accurate); the treebank
packages (tokenize to depparse only): English combined, ewt, gum, lines, partut, atis, childes, eslspok,
craft, genia, mimic;
German combined, gsd, hdt

options.name: --processors
options.description:
comma-separated, from tokenize,mwt,pos,lemma,constituency,depparse,sentiment,ner
(default: all of the package's)

options.name: --model
options.description:
a model for processor P instead of the package's (repeatable, or P=NAME,P=NAME), as Stanza's
processors dict: English constituency=ptb3_charlm; ner=ontonotes_charlm, ontonotes_nocharlm,
combined_charlm, conll03_charlm, i2b2, radiology (clinical),
anatem, bc4chemd, bc5cdr, bionlp13cg, jnlpba, linnaeus, ncbi_disease, s800 (biomedical),
ontonotes-ww-multi_electra-large; pos and depparse=combined_electra-large;
constituency=ptb3-revised_electra-large; sentiment=sstplus_electra-large (these five read the
1.3 GB google/electra-large-discriminator, which download fetches too); German ner=conll03.
Its processor is added if needed

options.name: --list
options.description: download: print each file and its MD5 instead of downloading

options.name: --models
options.description: compare, benchmark: the models (default: models/stanza/CODE)

options.name: --python
options.description: compare, benchmark: the Python with Stanza installed (default: python)

options.name: --threads
options.description:
benchmark: threads on both sides (default: each side's own default, StanzaSharp the
physical cores from 4 up, else all logical processors; torch the physical cores)

options.name: --words
options.description:
benchmark: the text's length in words, counted by whitespace (default: 1500); the block
counts words after tokenizing (2,009 for the default)

options.name: --quick
options.description: benchmark: 300 words (by whitespace), one run, 10 calls

options.name: --json
options.description: benchmark: also write the results as JSON
